title: Friends Land Developers v. State of U.P. — Clause 4.9 13th Amendment SPS-to-MPS challenge; Maxblis interim applied
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pritinker Diwaker and Ashutosh Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Maxblis order applied with tariff rider; connected and listed
headnote: Pending a challenge to the Electricity Supply Code (13th Amendment), 2018 — amending clause 4.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to convert Single Point Supply to Multi Point Supply — the Allahabad High Court made the order in connected Writ-C No. 4545 of 2019 (Maxblis Construction) operative for a similarly situated housing developer, with the rider that occupants of the multistorey towers be charged only as per the applicable tariff order for electricity supplied through the petitioner by the licensee. Vires was not decided; counter affidavits were directed and the petition was connected and listed.
facts: M/S Friends Land Developers, a registered partnership, developed the housing project "Gulmohar Greens" at 95, Katori Mill, Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, on a Single Point Supply design. Clause 4.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was later amended by the Electricity Supply Code (13th Amendment), 2018 to convert all Single Point Supply to Multi Point Supply. The firm challenged that amendment as ultra vires Articles 14, 19(1)(g) and 300A. Counsel agreed the same issue was already before the Court in Writ-C No. 4545 of 2019 (Maxblis Construction).

holding_units.topic: single-point to multi-point conversion (13th Amendment); interim protection
holding_units.holding: Without deciding the vires of the 13th Amendment to clause 4.9, the Court made the order operating in Writ-C No. 4545 of 2019 (Maxblis Construction) operative in this petition, subject to the rider that the developer shall charge occupants of the multistorey towers only the tariff as per the applicable tariff order for electricity supplied through it by the licensee. Respondents were to file counter affidavits; the matter was connected with the Maxblis writ and listed after six weeks.

principle_tags.application: Pending a vires challenge to the 13th Amendment of clause 4.9 converting Single Point Supply to Multi Point Supply, the Court extended the order in the lead Maxblis writ to this similarly situated developer, with a rider that occupants be charged only as per the applicable tariff order.

lead_authorities.name: M/S Maxblis Construction Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P.

not_decided.point: Whether the Electricity Supply Code (13th Amendment), 2018 amending clause 4.9 (Single Point Supply to Multi Point Supply) is ultra vires Articles 14, 19(1)(g) and 300A
not_decided.note: The Court applied the Maxblis order and connected the petition without deciding the constitutional challenge.
